description: Change or remove one planned post on the content calendar, by post_id from get_content_calendar: new text and hashtags in the owner's own words, a new planned_on (today to 90 days ahead), or remove: true. The text must fit the platform with its hashtags and carry no links, email addresses, phone numbers or anything that reads like instructions; posts planned before today can't be changed; offers and prices are the owner's to write. An edited post becomes the owner's and a new plan keeps it. Use only the words the owner gives; never write them for the owner. Ask the owner first. Owner, admin or operator; Live and Pro. Requires company:write; the account selects the business.
name: update_calendar_post
title: Change a planned post
